terra.problem: “Paul reminds the men” happens aboard the storm-driven ship after it has sailed from Crete, not at Crete.
The title “The storm after leaving Crete” is misleading: the storm struck while the ship was still sailing along Crete’s coast, then drove it away.
“Lee” is an unfamiliar sailing term for a 5th-grade reader. Explain it or use simpler wording.
